verdict.rationale: Salesforce Sales Cloud documents multiple AI-generated insight features embedded in the product—lead scoring, predictive forecasting, pipeline insights, and AI-surfaced deal intelligence—directly within the CRM workflow, backed by customer case studies (e.g., Crexi, 1916 Company) showing real usage impact. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of insight quality and no detailed technical documentation of the underlying AI models or accuracy benchmarks.
